Du hast deinen Grundriss als Bild? Dann: You have your floor plan as a picture? Then simply trace your house on top of it – in just a few minutes.
Mit L-förmigem Wohnzimmer, Theke, offene: With an L-shaped living room, a counter, an open hallway, doors and windows – and all of it live in 3D.
In Teil 1 legen wir den Bauplan unter, r: In part 1 we put the plan underneath, straighten it, and use the ruler to bring it to the right scale.
Dann zeichnen wir die Räume nach und ste: Then we trace the rooms and set up the walls. Doors follow in part 2, windows in part 3.
Du brauchst nur ein Foto oder einen Scan: All you need is a photo or a scan of your floor plan. I'm using an invented plan – scanned crooked on purpose.
Zuerst die Etage, wie in Folge 1: „Etage: First the floor, like in episode 1: “Add floor” – in German „Etage hinzufügen“ – and “Ground floor”.
Ganz unten in der Seitenleiste klappst d: At the very bottom of the side panel, open “Template (floor plan image)”, „Vorlage“, and click “Choose image”, „Bild wählen“.
PNG, JPG oder WebP – ein Handyfoto geht: PNG, JPG or WebP – a phone photo works too, as long as it's taken straight from above.
Das Bild liegt jetzt unter dem Raster –: The picture now lies under the grid – one square is one metre, and the picture starts out twelve metres wide. You can see right away: the plan is too small and crooked.
Mit „Deckkraft“ machst du es kräftiger o: “Opacity”, „Deckkraft“, makes it stronger or fainter. The template only exists here in the editor, not in 3D – and every floor has its own.
„Verschieben, skalieren und drehen“ gibt: “Move, scale and turn” – „Verschieben, skalieren und drehen“ – gives the picture handles, just like a piece of furniture.
Der Griff unten rechts macht es größer o: The handle at the bottom right makes it bigger or smaller.
Und der runde Griff oben dreht es – mit: And the round handle at the top turns it – hold Shift for 15-degree steps.
Rechts stehen die Werte dazu: X und Y, d: On the right you see the values: X and Y, the “Width in plan” and the “Rotation”, accurate to a tenth of a degree.
Nach Augenmaß wird es aber nie ganz gena: But by eye it's never quite exact. I set the rotation back to zero and tap “Done”, „Fertig“.
Jetzt liegt das Bild fest und du zeichne: Now the picture is fixed and you can draw over it undisturbed – the hint in the form says so too.
It's more precise with “Straighten”, „Gerade ausrichten“. The button then turns into “Cancel straightening” – in case you change your mind.
Tipp auf den Anfang einer langen Wand, d: Tap the start of a long wall that should be straight – here the outer wall at the top –
und dann auf ihr Ende. Das Bild dreht si: and then its end. The picture turns to fit.
Jetzt läuft die Wand genau am Raster ent: Now the wall runs exactly along the grid. The rotation shows 2.5 degrees.
Jetzt der Maßstab. Mit dem Mausrad zoome: Now the scale. I zoom out a little with the mouse wheel – you move the view by dragging on an empty spot. On a tablet you do both with two fingers.
Für das Lineal brauchst du eine Strecke,: For the ruler – “Scale with a ruler” – you need a distance whose length you know. Best is the longest dimension line in the plan: 14 metres. Here too, the button now says “Cancel the ruler”.
Ich tippe auf den Anfang der Maßlinie …: I tap the start of the dimension line … and its end.
Rechts steht, was NeonPlan gemessen hat: On the right you see what NeonPlan measured – a lot less. I enter the real length: 14 – and “Apply the scale”, „Maßstab übernehmen“.
Das Bild wächst passend, der erste Punkt: The picture grows to fit, and the first point stays where it is. To check: the garage is now three and a half squares wide.
Zum Schluss schiebe ich die Hausecke gen: Finally I move the corner of the house exactly onto a grid point – then the rooms snap neatly onto the walls while you draw.
Merk dir die Reihenfolge: erst gerade au: Remember the order: straighten first, then the scale, then draw. And “Remove template”, „Vorlage entfernen“, takes the picture away again.
Rechteckige Räume ziehst du wie in Folge: Rectangular rooms you drag out with “Rectangle”, „Rechteck“, like in episode 1 – here the garage, from corner to corner.
Für das L-förmige Wohnzimmer nimmst du „: For the L-shaped living room you use “Free shape”, „Freie Form“, and set one point after another on the corners.
Unten steht immer der Hinweis zum Werkze: The hint for the tool is always shown at the bottom. Corners snap to the grid, to the corners and edges of other rooms, and to their alignment lines.
Mit gedrückter Alt-Taste setzt du Punkte: Hold Alt to place points without snapping. You close the shape by tapping the first point – or with Enter. Escape cancels.
Küche, Flur, Bad und Schlafzimmer sind R: Kitchen, hallway, bathroom and bedroom are rectangles – they're done in no time.
Die Ecken rasten an den Nachbarräumen ei: The corners snap to the neighbouring rooms – so there are no gaps between the rooms.
Die Räume verknüpfst du dann mit ihren B: Then you link the rooms to their Home Assistant areas – just like in episode 1.
One corner of the living room is off. With “Select”, „Auswählen“, tap the room and drag the corner to the right spot.
Das kleine Plus in der Mitte jeder Kante: The small plus in the middle of each edge adds a new point – for a bay window, say. Tap it, then drag the new point.
Rechts in der Liste „Eckpunkte“ steht je: On the right, the “Corners” list, „Eckpunkte“, shows every corner with X and Y – you can type measurements straight in. The cross deletes a point.
Die Pfeiltasten schieben das Ausgewählte: The arrow keys move the selection by one grid step, with Shift by ten centimetres, with Alt by one.
Und alles nimmt Strg+Z zurück – oder obe: And Ctrl+Z undoes anything – or “Undo” at the top, „Rückgängig“. “Redo” brings it back, and “Show all”, „Alles zeigen“, fits all rooms into view.
Die Wände entstehen von selbst: Jede gem: The walls appear by themselves: every shared edge becomes an interior wall, every outer edge an exterior wall. Corners and T-joints are joined cleanly.
Ihre Stärken stehen unten unter „Einstel: Their thickness is set further down under “Settings”, „Einstellungen“. In the plan the exterior walls are 30 centimetres thick – so I enter 0.3 for “Exterior wall”.
Jetzt ins Wohnzimmer: Im Kasten „Wandhöh: Now the living room: the “Wall heights” box, „Wandhöhen“, lists every wall of the room, named after the corner numbers in the plan, with its length.
Fährst du über eine Zeile, leuchtet die: Hover over a row and the wall lights up in the plan. Where a neighbouring room only touches part of a wall, you get separate rows: part 1 and part 2.
Zur Küche gibt es laut Plan auf zwei Met: According to the plan there's a two-metre counter towards the kitchen. So I split “Wand 2–3” with the scissors.
Der Teilpunkt sitzt in der Mitte. Unter: The split point sits in the middle. You move it with “Split point from corner”, and the cross joins the parts again.
Teil 1 bekommt die Höhe 1,1 Meter – scho: Part 1 gets a height of 1.1 metres – and there's the counter. Low walls look lighter in the plan, and windows and doors in them end at the wall height.
Der Pfeil nach oben setzt eine Wand wied: The up arrow puts a wall back to full height. When two rooms share a wall, the lower height wins.
Zum Flur ist der Essbereich offen: bei „: The dining area is open to the hallway: on “Wand 3–4” click “No wall”, „Keine Wand“. In Home Assistant they stay separate areas, and light shines through.
Jede Wand hat außerdem ein Feld „Dicke“: Every wall also has a “Thickness” field – for that one thicker exterior wall or a thin partition. The circular arrow resets it to the house setting.
Teilen sich zwei Räume eine Wand, gilt d: When two rooms share a wall, the thicker setting wins – and the wall stays centred on the boundary.
Bleibt der Raumteiler. Dafür gibt es obe: That leaves the room divider. For that there's the “Wall” tool at the top, „Wand“: just drag. Shift keeps it straight, Alt draws without snapping.
Trifft sie auf eine Raumwand, wird die E: Where it meets a room wall, the corner is joined cleanly. On the right you have “Length”, “Wall thickness” and “Height”.
Laut Plan: zwei Meter lang, zehn Zentime: According to the plan: two metres long, ten centimetres thick and 1.20 high – a half-height wall.
Die Enden ziehst du an den Griffen, die: You drag the ends by their handles and the whole wall by its line. Doors and windows work in single walls too – and “Delete” removes them along with it.
Jetzt die Kontrolle: „3D daneben“ zeigt: Now let's check: “3D beside”, „3D daneben“, shows the house right next to the plan.
Oben schaltest du zwischen „Wände hoch“: At the top you switch between “Tall walls”, „Wände hoch“ – all walls at full height – and “Cut”, „Schnitt“: then they're cut off at hip height.
Da sind sie: die Theke zur Küche, der of: There they are: the counter to the kitchen, the open hallway, the garage and the half-height divider in the living room.
Das war Teil 1: Bauplan einrichten, Räum: That was part 1: setting up the plan, tracing the rooms, adjusting the walls. Part 2 adds the doors and the garage door, part 3 the windows – with contacts and blinds.
Links zur Online-Demo und zur Anleitung: Links to the online demo and the manual are in the description. And NeonPlan runs on old wall tablets too. See you in part 2!
